en: This postcard features a black-and-white historical photograph of two German military officers in uniform standing on a cobblestone street next to a metal fence and stone wall. There are buildings and a quiet street in the background. The left side of the image contains printed German text and publishing information, while the bottom prominently features a caption in German about Generaloberst von Heeringen. The reverse side contains standard postcard layout sections for writing and address, as well as stamps indicating Bad Pyrmont and publisher information.
